title: Add security-engineer agent to the workflow (both stages)
description: Add an 8th agent, security-engineer, as a first-class tracked participant in the HookBox agent pipeline (the workflow is one bd graph). Read-only like qa-engineer; files defects as bd bugs routed to area:frontend/area:backend; never edits source.
design: Placement = BOTH stages (user decision). Stage A: threat-model critic parallel to journey/ux/architecture (writes docs/features/<slug>/security.md), feeding PM REVISE so security ACs/§5 notes land in the frozen PRD. Stage B: post-QA code-review gate (area:security) depending on the QA gate; reviews implemented code, files bd bugs, loops with engineers (capped+stall-guarded) before sync. SYNC depends on the security gate.
acceptance_criteria: 1) .claude/agents/security-engineer.md exists (2 modes, read-only, opus). 2) init-feature-graph.sh creates step:security blocking prd-revise. 3) build-feature.md runs it in Stage A parallel critique + REVISE folds security.md. 4) product-manager BREAKDOWN creates area:security gate (QA→security→sync). 5) implement-feature.js runs a Security phase+loop after QA, before Sync. 6) agents/README.md updated (cast, labels, mermaid, narrative).
close_reason: Added security-engineer agent across both stages. Stage A: step:security threat-model critic (parallel to journey/ux/architecture, gates prd-revise) in init-feature-graph.sh + build-feature.md; PM REVISE folds security.md. Stage B: area:security code-review gate (QA→security→sync) in PM BREAKDOWN + implement-feature.js Security phase/loop (cap 4 + stall guard, skipped if QA fails). README cast/labels/mermaid/narrative updated. Verified: bootstrap dep graph wires correctly (security ∥ critics, blocks revise) + no cycles; workflow JS parses.
